description_en: Modifies the zones and zone attributes of a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 修改网络型负载均衡实例可用区及可用区属性
kebab_example: aliyun nlb update-load-balancer-zones --load-balancer-id nlb-83ckzc8d4xlp8o0000 --zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-a VSwitchId=vsw-bp1rmcrwg3erh1fh80000 AllocationId=eip-bp1aedxso6u80u0qf0000 EipType=Common PrivateIPv4Address=192.168.36.16 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLoadBalancerZones

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP) or Anycast EIP
fields.help_zh: 弹性公网IP或任播弹性公网IP的实例ID
fields.name: allocation_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the EIP. Valid values:

Common: an EIP

Anycast: an Anycast EIP

For regions that support Anycast EIPs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470000.html.This parameter is required if AddressType is set to Internet
fields.help_zh:
公网EIP的类型。取值：

Common：弹性公网IP，简称EIP。
Anycast：任播弹性公网IP，简称Anycast EIP。

支持绑定Anycast EIP的地域见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470000.html，**AddressType**配置为**Internet**时，需要配置该参数
fields.name: eip_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the zone. By default, each zone uses one vSwitch and one subnet
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区默认使用一台交换机和一个子网
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html operation to query the most recent zone list
fields.help_zh: 可用区ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443890.html接口获取
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The mappings between the zones and the vSwitches. You can specify up to 10 zones
parameters.help_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表，最多支持添加10个可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: validates the request without performing the operation. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the validation, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the validation, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): validates the request and performs the request. If the request passes the validation, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改实例可用区属性。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP_2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not set this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.\\ The value of RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of region where the NLB instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

JobId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task
